data.title: 贝尔法斯特 · 黎明的阳台
data.description: 天还未亮透，贝尔法斯特穿着居家袍站在阳台，双手捧杯，目送第一艘船离港。
data.promptProse: Before full sunrise on her quiet port bedroom balcony, Belfast stands beside the painted railing wrapped in her belted pale silver-blue satin robe. She cradles a steaming porcelain cup between both palms, gazing calmly out across the steel-blue harbor as the first vessel clears the breakwater in the distance. Pale dawn light breaks along the horizon, tinting the sea mist and the soft sheen of her sleeves.
data.animaCaption: Standing by the balcony railing in her pale satin robe, Belfast cradles a steaming cup with both hands and watches the first ship depart across the harbor. Early dawn light softly rims the sea horizon and her shoulders.
